verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a community user who mentions using SolidStart, a Solid-based framework with routing, and reports that its routing is occasionally very slow with no workaround. That confirms a meta-framework exists and is used, but the pack has no first-party description of it, its official status, or its data fetching. Missing for 10: first-party docs establishing SolidStart as the official meta-framework, documented routing and server data-fetching/full-stack features, and positive hands-on corroboration.
